headline: Hands-on previews find Zelda: Ocarina of Time Switch 2 remake surprisingly scary
summary: Hands-on previews of Nintendo's Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time found more than a visual glow-up: Hyrule has been prettified with a newly orchestrated soundtrack, and gameplay changes make the 1998 classic feel remarkably modern, while some previews found it surprisingly terrifying in its new 4K visuals.
